steps: Reconfirm exact-source green CI, secrets, bindings, version and sanitized DNS baseline
Attach only the apex hkgpipi.com Custom Domain to hkgpipi-enquiry-production
Wait for and verify the Cloudflare-managed edge certificate
Verify TLS 1.2 minimum and TLS 1.3 where supported
Verify production routes, CSP and security headers before any submission
Enable Cloudflare Always Use HTTPS and verify a permanent edge redirect from http://hkgpipi.com to https://hkgpipi.com
After HTTPS and rollback checks, enable HSTS max-age 15552000 without includeSubDomains or preload
Run production browser/runtime qualification and exactly one controlled enquiry
Only after live qualification, execute the approved Google and Bing search runbook
wwwPolicy: Absent today; do not create during Gate 10A. If later authorized, permanently redirect to https://hkgpipi.com and never serve duplicate canonical content
